head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Saved firmware operation recovery inspection, strict global Unix IPC and CLI. Private-file/MockBackend only. No HID query, real device, production daemon launch, native GUI, host D-Bus, replay, flash or quarantine resolution.
implementation: Typed saved states: no_saved_operation, journal_only, guarded, guard_only, inconsistent, unreadable. Reconstruct saved operation/stage/target/image/progress and guards from original journal/device TOML; no new persistent format.

Shared state mutex acquired via separate readonly_access: pending profile/settings transaction refuses inspection without redo. No directory creation or repair. Journal raw snapshots compared before/after device guard scan; schema/no-follow file checks and existing file bounds retained. Device directory capped at256entries.

get_firmware_recovery accepts exactly an empty JSON object, has no DeviceId/external-path/action parameters and remains available with closed ordinary admission. Two separate semaphore permits are held by actual blocking readers if caller is lost.
lconnectctl [--json] firmware-recovery connects once without resolving a device. Human output is English and labels the result as saved artifacts, not live status, success or retry permission.
No write token reconstruction, automatic retry, probe, restore, guard clearing or replay. Saved inspection can coexist with live job; absence of journal before arm is not evidence that no job exists.

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native app source change
checks.external_pinned_transfer_fixture: not rerun; no transfer protocol/actor changes in this checkpoint

coverage: Missing store produces no_saved_operation without creating files.
All five saved stages survive reopening the store; raw journal/settings files unchanged. AwaitingReconnect preserves619echoes without success claim.
Missing journal ->guard_only; missing guarded settings/effects marker ->inconsistent; mismatched operation ID or extra guard ->inconsistent; markers not repaired or retargeted.
Corrupt/oversized/symlink journal, malformed settings, valid pending redo transaction and excessive directory entries ->unreadable, preserving original artifacts.

Real CLI ->private Unix socket ->IpcServerImpl works with zero devices and sealed admission while ordinary list_devices is refused. JSON status equals direct RPC; English output explains verification/saved-only limitations.
RPC rejects device/path/clear fields and arrays. Initial regression exposed serde accepting an empty array as a zero-field struct; endpoint now explicitly requires empty JSON object.
Journal loss remains visible through the same global RPC; original settings guard persists and ordinary admission count stayszero.
limits: Saved reconstruction does not resume a pre-crash worker or prove old actor teardown/fresh reset.
No product live-status/Tauri EN/RU recovery UI or Apply/probe/clear endpoint yet.
Owned reconnect probe integration, qualified resolution/restoration and serial-less/missed reset/restart policy remain.
Extended lifecycle/power/blocked-I/O fault/deadline matrix and hardware image/revision/cooling qualification remain.
